items.q: How do I add it to OBS?
items.a: Copy the overlay URL, add a Browser Source, paste the URL, set the size, and enable a transparent background. The docs page has the short version.

items.q: Does ChesStats store my Chess.com or Lichess password?
items.a: No. Only the public username goes into the overlay URL. Passwords are never requested or stored.

items.q: Will changing the site language break my OBS source?
items.a: No. Overlay URLs stay at /overlay and do not include a language prefix.

about.metaDescription: ChesStats is an independent open source overlay for chess streamers. It is not affiliated with Chess.com or Lichess.
about.title: About ChesStats
paragraphs: ChesStats is a free, open source overlay that shows live Chess.com and Lichess statistics inside OBS and other broadcasting tools.
It is built for chess streamers who want rating change, record, win rate, and streak on screen without creating an account.
ChesStats is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Chess.com or Lichess.
attribution: Player and game data comes from the public Chess.com Published Data API and the public Lichess API. Those services, their names, and their trademarks belong to their respective owners.
ChesStats does not ask for Chess.com or Lichess passwords.

privacy.metaDescription: How ChesStats handles usernames, overlay settings, and public chess APIs.
privacy.title: Privacy
paragraphs: ChesStats does not require an account for the basic overlay. Overlay settings are saved in your browser with localStorage. They are not uploaded to a ChesStats account.
The overlay URL contains the chess username and the display options you chose. Anyone with that URL can request the same public statistics.
Usernames are sent to Chess.com or Lichess through the public APIs those sites provide. ChesStats does not collect or store chess passwords.
The language choice is stored in a cookie named chesstats-locale so the site can open in the same language next time.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the free ChesStats chess overlay.
terms.title: Terms
paragraphs: ChesStats is provided for free and as open source software, without a warranty. Streaming tools, chess sites, and their APIs can change or be unavailable.
You are responsible for the usernames, colors, and images you put in an overlay, including any sponsor logo URL.
Chess.com and Lichess are trademarks of their respective owners. Using ChesStats does not create a relationship with those companies.

items: Free Chess.com and Lichess overlay for OBS, with rating change, record, win rate, and streak.
Landing page in English and Portuguese, with a language choice that stays in a cookie.
Overlay and API URLs stay unprefixed, so existing browser sources keep working.
Create my overlay opens the configurator directly, with a sticky preview.
Copy URL unlocks when the primary username is filled. Start counter is only for marking a live session.

docs.metaDescription: Add a ChesStats chess overlay to OBS as a browser source.
docs.title: Add the overlay to OBS
docs.intro: You do not need a plugin. OBS loads the overlay as a browser source.
steps: Choose Create my overlay and enter your Chess.com or Lichess username.
Choose the mode and click Start counter if you want stats for the current stream only.
In OBS, add a source and choose Browser.
Paste the URL. Set the width to about 420 pixels, or about 840 if you show two sites. Set the height to about 220.
Turn on a transparent background, then place the source over your board.
docs.note: The same URL works in other tools that support a browser source, including Streamlabs.
